reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is the first one that names the lab and puts the batch report on the page, with a stated 200 mg dose and no oxide. At $24.99 for one box, with a money-back guarantee, I'll try one box and read the report first.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I want to open the actual lab report and check that the batch number matches before I trust it. A brand-new brand with only 1,000 boxes has no reviews yet.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch was missing, unreadable or did not match the box, or the lab was not a real named lab, I would not buy.
